title: Stroke-Heart Syndrome: Mechanisms, Temporal Phenotypes, and Diagnostic Reasoning.
summary: Stroke-heart syndrome (SHS) encompasses new or worsened cardiac abnormalities that arise after acute stroke, most often within the first 30 days and with an early peak. Its spectrum includes acute myocardial injury, electrocardiographic changes, arrhythmia, ventricular dysfunction, Takotsubo syndrome, and heart failure, but similar findings may reflect antecedent cardiac disease or systemic illness. This Review defines the accepted clinical boundaries of SHS and integrates central autonomic network disruption, neuroendocrine stress, inflammation, endothelial and microvascular dysfunction, oxygen supply-demand imbalance, and premorbid substrate into a time-resolved framework. Eight provisional, non-mutually-exclusive phenotypic domains are proposed to organize current evidence without implying validated endotypes. A diagnostic approach based on symptom chronology, prior cardiac data, serial troponin and electrocardiography, rhythm monitoring, echocardiography, selective coronary assessment, and cardiac magnetic resonance is presented to distinguish stroke-triggered injury from recent myocardial infarction, pre-existing atrial fibrillation, chronic myocardial injury, and established heart failure. No syndrome-specific treatment is validated; care should prioritize recognized cardiac emergencies, correction of reversible stressors, and coordinated stroke-cardiology decision-making. Prospective studies with documented premorbid status, standardized time points, and blinded adjudication are needed to validate the proposed phenotypes and determine whether they improve outcomes.

AI.tldr: 卒中-心脏综合征是急性卒中后30天内出现或加重的心脏异常，机制涉及中枢自主网络破坏等多因素，诊断需结合时间线和系列检查，目前无特异性治疗。

AI.method: 本文为综述，整合中枢自主网络破坏、神经内分泌应激、炎症、内皮和微血管功能障碍、氧供需失衡及病前基质等机制，提出8个临时性、非互斥的表型域，并基于症状时间线、既往心脏资料、系列肌钙蛋白和心电图、节律监测、超声心动图、选择性冠脉评估和心脏磁共振构建诊断路径。摘要未报告系统检索策略或样本量。

title: Deep learning analysis of sinus-rhythm echocardiography for the identification of patients with atrial fibrillation.
summary:
AIMS: Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF) is underdiagnosed due to its intermittent and asymptomatic nature. We evaluated whether a deep neural network (DNN) applied to transthoracic echocardiograms (TTEs) acquired in sinus rhythm can discriminate between patients with and without documented AF and identify individuals at increased risk for subsequent AF documentation and adverse outcomes.

METHODS AND RESULTS: We retrospectively analysed 85 686 TTE studies (2009-21). A DNN was applied to apical four-chamber and parasternal long-axis videos without Doppler. AF ground truth was based on International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes, electrocardiogram, Holter, or prior echocardiographic documentation of AF. The dataset was split into training (60%), validation (20%), and an independent test set (20%). In the test cohort, we assessed discrimination performance. Among patients without prior AF, we evaluated associations between model classification and subsequent AF documentation and a composite outcome of all-cause mortality, heart failure hospitalization, or stroke. The test set included 17 121 patients (median age 66 years [interquartile range, IQR 54-75]; 57.6% male), of whom 3449 (20.1%) had prior AF. The model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.85, with sensitivity 0.80 and specificity 0.72. At the selected threshold, 6581 patients (38.4%) were classified as model-positive, including 3832 (58.2%) without prior AF. Among patients without prior AF, model-positive classification was associated with subsequent AF documentation [adjusted hazard ratio (HR) 1.64; 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.33-2.04] and with the composite outcome (adjusted HR 1.24; 95% CI 1.13-1.35).

CONCLUSION: Deep learning applied to sinus-rhythm TTE demonstrates discrimination for AF and identifies an imaging-derived signal associated with subsequent AF documentation and adverse outcomes.

AI.tldr: 在窦性心律经胸超声心动图上应用深度学习模型可区分有无房颤病史（AUC 0.85），且模型阳性者后续房颤记录及不良复合终点风险显著升高。
AI.motivation: 阵发性房颤因发作间歇性和无症状性而常被漏诊，既往缺乏可在窦性心律状态下、基于常规影像识别房颤易感人群的简便筛查工具；本研究评估深度学习能否从窦性心律经胸超声心动图中识别已确诊房颤患者，并预测后续房颤记录与不良结局。
AI.method: 回顾性分析2009—2021年85 686例经胸超声心动图检查，取无心房多普勒的 apical four-chamber 与 parasternal long-axis 视频输入深度神经网络；房颤真值依据ICD编码、心电图、Holter或既往超声记录的房颤确定。数据按60%/20%/20%分为训练集、验证集与独立测试集，在测试集评估判别性能（AUC、敏感度、特异度），并在既往无房颤患者中分析模型分类与后续房颤记录及全因死亡、心衰住院或卒中复合终点的关联（校正后HR）。
AI.result: 测试集17 121例，中位年龄66岁（IQR 54–75），男性57.6%，其中3449例（20.1%）有既往房颤。模型AUC 0.85，敏感度0.80、特异度0.72；所选阈值下6581例（38.4%）被判为模型阳性，其中3832例（58.2%）无既往房颤。在无既往房颤者中，模型阳性与后续房颤记录相关（校正HR 1.64；95%CI 1.33–2.04），也与复合终点相关（校正HR 1.24；95%CI 1.13–1.35）。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习可从窦性心律经胸超声心动图中提取与房颤相关的影像信号，用于识别已确诊房颤及后续房颤记录和不良结局风险升高的人群，为机会性筛查提供新思路；但本研究为回顾性设计、房颤真值依赖编码与病历记录，存在漏诊与错分可能，且模型阳性阈值下特异度有限，尚需前瞻性外部验证后方可用于临床决策。

summary_zh:
目的：阵发性心房颤动（AF）因其间歇性和无症状性而诊断不足。我们评估了将深度神经网络（DNN）应用于窦性心律下获取的经胸超声心动图（TTE）能否区分有和无AF记录的患者，并识别后续AF记录和不良结局风险增加的个体。

方法与结果：我们回顾性分析了85 686份TTE检查（2009-21年）。将DNN应用于无多普勒的心尖四腔和胸骨旁长轴视频。AF的真实性基于国际疾病分类（ICD）代码、心电图、动态心电图或既往超声心动图记录的AF。数据集分为训练集（60%）、验证集（20%）和独立测试集（20%）。在测试队列中，我们评估了判别性能。在无既往AF的患者中，我们评估了模型分类与后续AF记录以及全因死亡、心力衰竭住院或卒中的复合结局之间的关联。测试集包括17 121名患者（中位年龄66岁[四分位距，IQR 54-75]；57.6%为男性），其中3449名（20.1%）有既往AF。模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.85，敏感性0.80，特异性0.72。在选定的阈值下，6581名患者（38.4%）被分类为模型阳性，包括3832名（58.2%）无既往AF。在无既往AF的患者中，模型阳性分类与后续AF记录相关[调整风险比（HR）1.64；95%置信区间（CI）1.33-2.04]，并与复合结局相关（调整HR 1.24；95% CI 1.13-1.35）。

结论：深度学习应用于窦性心律TTE显示出对AF的判别能力，并识别出与后续AF记录和不良结局相关的影像衍生信号。

title: Malignant Ventricular Arrhythmias following Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A systematic review of published cases and mechanistic insights.
Impact of obesity on clinical outcomes and the treatment effect of catheter ablation in atrial fibrillation: insights from CABANA.
summary:
AIMS: Obesity and atrial fibrillation (AF) are global epidemics, often co-existing and compounding cardiovascular risk. While catheter ablation has emerged as an effective strategy for rhythm control in symptomatic AF, it remains unclear whether obesity modifies its benefit. This post hoc analysis of the CABANA trial investigates the influence of baseline obesity on clinical outcomes after catheter ablation vs. drug therapy in AF patients.

METHODS AND RESULTS: A total of 2170 CABANA participants with available body mass index (BMI) were included. Obesity was defined by BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2, and Class II obesity by BMI ≥ 35 kg/m2. Adverse outcomes, AF recurrence, and functional status were analysed using Cox, mixed-effects, and generalized estimating equation models, assessing treatment-by-obesity interactions. Obese patients exhibited higher comorbidity burden, worse baseline functional status, and more persistent AF compared to non-obese counterparts. Higher BMI was associated with increased cardiovascular hospitalization and a higher New York Heart Association functional class. Catheter ablation significantly reduced the risk of AF recurrence and improved symptom burden and functional capacity, irrespective of obesity status. No significant interaction was found between BMI and treatment effect on the primary composite endpoint of cardiovascular hospitalization or all-cause mortality. However, patients with Class II obesity or higher had worse absolute outcomes despite similar relative benefits from ablation.

CONCLUSION: While obesity is associated with worse baseline status and outcomes, it was not shown to significantly alter the relative effectiveness of AF ablation compared to drug therapy. These findings support a multifaceted approach integrating rhythm control with upstream interventions targeting obesity-related atrial remodelling and comorbidity management.

AI.tldr: CABANA事后分析显示，肥胖不影响导管消融相对药物治疗的疗效，但II度及以上肥胖患者绝对预后更差。
AI.motivation: 肥胖与房颤常共存并加重心血管风险，导管消融是症状性房颤的有效节律控制手段，但肥胖是否改变其获益尚不明确。
AI.method: CABANA试验事后分析，纳入2170例有BMI数据的房颤患者，肥胖定义为BMI≥30 kg/m2，II度肥胖为BMI≥35 kg/m2。比较导管消融与药物治疗，终点包括心血管住院或全因死亡复合终点、房颤复发和功能状态，采用Cox、混合效应和广义估计方程模型分析，并评估治疗与肥胖的交互作用。
AI.result: 肥胖患者合并症更多、基线功能状态更差、持续性房颤比例更高。较高BMI与心血管住院增加和NYHA功能分级更高相关。导管消融显著降低房颤复发风险并改善症状负担和功能能力，无论肥胖状态如何。BMI与治疗效应在主要复合终点上无显著交互作用。但II度及以上肥胖患者绝对结局更差，尽管相对获益相似。
AI.conclusion: 肥胖与更差的基线状态和结局相关，但未显著改变房颤消融相对于药物治疗的相对有效性。这些发现支持整合节律控制与针对肥胖相关心房重构和合并症管理的上游干预的多方面策略。

summary_zh:
目的：肥胖和心房颤动（AF）是全球性的流行病，常共同存在并加剧心血管风险。虽然导管消融已成为症状性AF节律控制的有效策略，但肥胖是否改变其获益仍不清楚。这项CABANA试验的事后分析探讨基线肥胖对AF患者导管消融与药物治疗后临床结局的影响。

方法和结果：共纳入2170名有体重指数（BMI）数据的CABANA参与者。肥胖定义为BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2，II级肥胖定义为BMI ≥ 35 kg/m2。使用Cox、混合效应和广义估计方程模型分析不良结局、AF复发和功能状态，评估治疗与肥胖的交互作用。与非肥胖患者相比，肥胖患者合并症负担更高、基线功能状态更差、持续性AF更多。较高的BMI与心血管住院增加和较高的纽约心脏协会功能分级相关。无论肥胖状态如何，导管消融均显著降低AF复发风险并改善症状负担和功能能力。未发现BMI与治疗效应在心血管住院或全因死亡的主要复合终点上存在显著交互作用。然而，尽管消融的相对获益相似，II级或更高肥胖患者的绝对结局更差。

结论：虽然肥胖与较差的基线状态和结局相关，但并未显示其显著改变AF消融相对于药物治疗的相对有效性。这些发现支持采取多方面的方法，将节律控制与针对肥胖相关心房重构和合并症管理的上游干预相结合。

title: Impact of obesity on procedural safety and 1-year outcomes after pulsed-field ablation for atrial fibrillation.
summary:
AIMS: Obesity is associated with atrial fibrillation (AF), atrial remodelling, and cardiometabolic comorbidities. Whether baseline body mass index (BMI) influences procedural safety and effectiveness of pulsed-field ablation (PFA) remains uncertain. We evaluated the association of baseline BMI with procedural characteristics, periprocedural safety, and 1-year arrhythmia recurrence after first-time PFA for AF.

METHODS AND RESULTS: FRANCE-PFA is a nationwide registry including consecutive patients undergoing first-time AF ablation with a pentaspline PFA catheter. Patients with available BMI were categorized as <25, 25 to <30, 30 to <35, or ≥35 kg/m2. Periprocedural complications and 1-year atrial arrhythmia recurrence were assessed across BMI categories. Among 5223 patients, BMI was available in 4573 (87.6%). Higher BMI was associated with greater cardiometabolic burden, more persistent AF, larger atria, and more extensive ablation strategies, including fewer pulmonary vein isolation-only procedures and more additional lesion sets (all P < 0.001). Periprocedural complications remained infrequent (1.0%), with no significant difference across BMI categories. At 1 year, recurrence was driven mainly by AF type rather than obesity. Within paroxysmal and non-paroxysmal AF, recurrence rates were comparable between patients with BMI < 35 and ≥35 kg/m2 (13.8% vs. 9.1% and 22.9% vs. 23.3%, respectively; log-rank P = 0.925). Severe obesity was not associated with recurrence after multivariable adjustment (HR, 0.86; 95% CI, 0.65-1.14; P = 0.299), with similar findings when BMI was analysed continuously.

CONCLUSION: In this nationwide PFA cohort, higher BMI identified a more advanced AF phenotype and more extensive ablation strategies but was not independently associated with periprocedural complications or 1-year arrhythmia recurrence.

AI.tldr: 在FRANCE-PFA全国注册研究中，高BMI与更晚期房颤表型和更广泛消融策略相关，但并非围术期并发症或1年心律失常复发的独立预测因素。
AI.motivation: 肥胖与房颤、心房重构及心血管代谢合并症相关，但基线BMI是否影响脉冲场消融（PFA）的手术安全性和有效性尚不明确，既往证据有限。
AI.method: FRANCE-PFA为全国性注册研究，连续纳入首次接受五分支PFA导管房颤消融的患者。按BMI分为<25、25-<30、30-<35、≥35 kg/m2四组，评估围术期并发症和1年房性心律失常复发，采用多变量Cox回归分析BMI与复发的关联。
AI.result: 5223例患者中4573例（87.6%）有BMI数据。高BMI与更重的心血管代谢负担、更多持续性房颤、更大左房及更广泛消融策略相关（均P<0.001）。围术期并发症发生率1.0%，各BMI组无显著差异。1年复发主要由房颤类型驱动：阵发性房颤中BMI<35 vs ≥35组复发率13.8% vs 9.1%，非阵发性房颤中22.9% vs 23.3%（log-rank P=0.925）。多变量校正后，严重肥胖与复发无关（HR 0.86；95%CI 0.65-1.14；P=0.299），BMI连续分析结果相似。
AI.conclusion: 在该全国性PFA队列中，高BMI提示更晚期房颤表型和更广泛消融策略，但并非围术期并发症或1年心律失常复发的独立危险因素。这支持PFA在肥胖房颤患者中的安全性，但研究为观察性注册，残余混杂可能影响因果推断。

summary_zh:
目的：肥胖与心房颤动（AF）、心房重构及心脏代谢合并症相关。基线体重指数（BMI）是否影响脉冲场消融（PFA）的手术安全性和有效性仍不确定。我们评估了基线BMI与首次AF的PFA术后手术特征、围术期安全性及1年心律失常复发之间的关联。

方法与结果：FRANCE-PFA是一项全国性注册研究，连续纳入使用五分支PFA导管接受首次AF消融的患者。有BMI数据的患者被分为<25、25至<30、30至<35或≥35 kg/m2。评估不同BMI类别间的围术期并发症和1年房性心律失常复发。在5223例患者中，4573例（87.6%）有BMI数据。较高的BMI与更大的心脏代谢负担、更多的持续性AF、更大的心房以及更广泛的消融策略相关，包括更少的单纯肺静脉隔离手术和更多的额外消融集（所有P < 0.001）。围术期并发症仍然少见（1.0%），不同BMI类别间无显著差异。1年时，复发主要由AF类型而非肥胖驱动。在阵发性和非阵发性AF中，BMI < 35与≥35 kg/m2的患者复发率相当（分别为13.8% vs. 9.1%和22.9% vs. 23.3%；log-rank P = 0.925）。多变量调整后，重度肥胖与复发无关（HR，0.86；95% CI，0.65-1.14；P = 0.299），当BMI作为连续变量分析时也得到类似结果。

结论：在这个全国性PFA队列中，较高的BMI识别出更晚期的AF表型和更广泛的消融策略，但与围术期并发症或1年心律失常复发无独立关联。

title: The weight of evidence: does obesity really not matter for atrial fibrillation ablation? Lessons from CABANA.
Optimization of direct oral anticoagulant prescribing in primary care: a pharmacotherapeutic review in real-world clinical practice and therapeutic efficiency.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Direct oral anticoagulants are among the first-line treatments for stroke prevention in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation and for the treatment and secondary prevention of venous thromboembolism. The increasing use of these agents poses challenges related to prescribing appropriateness, clinical safety. This study aims to evaluate the impact of a primary care pharmacist-led intervention on the appropriateness of DOAC prescribing, pharmacotherapeutic efficiency, and clinical outcomes.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective, quasi-experimental before-and-after study was conducted in the healthcare area of Xarxa Santa Tecla (Tarragonès and Baix Penedès, Spain). 791 patients receiving DOAC therapy were included. The intervention comprised multidisciplinary educational activities, individualized pharmacotherapeutic review, and communication of recommendations to prescribers.

RESULTS: The mean age was 78.2 years, and 43.2% of patients had moderate or severe renal impairment. The pharmacotherapeutic review identified 527 patients (66.6%) as candidates for treatment optimization, through a proposed switch from apixaban to dabigatran. The pharmacist intervention was associated with changes in prescribing patterns among newly initiated patients, increasing the use of dabigatran. The economic analysis estimated savings of €75,508.81 from new treatment initiations and €31,288.25 from therapeutic switches, resulting in total savings of €106,797.06 in 2025. The overall bleeding rate remained stable (5.3% in 2024% vs. 5.2% in 2025), with no deterioration in clinical safety. In conclusion, a structured, multidisciplinary, and coordinated primary care pharmacist-led intervention promoted a more efficient use of healthcare resources, while no deterioration in population-level safety indicators was observed. These findings reinforce the role of primary care pharmacists in optimizing anticoagulant therapy.

title: CHAMPION-AF and left atrial appendage closure: non-inferiority or a trade-off in risk?
summary: The Watchman FLX versus Novel Oral Anticoagulation for Embolic Protection in the Management of Patients with Non-Valvular Atrial Fibrillation (CHAMPION-AF) trial compared left atrial appendage (LAA) closure using the Watchman FLX device with non-vitamin K antagonist oral anticoagulants (NOACs) in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation eligible for long-term anticoagulation. LAA closure demonstrated non-inferiority for the composite endpoint of cardiovascular death, stroke, or systemic embolism and reduced non-procedure-related bleeding. However, interpretation is limited by a permissive non-inferiority margin, reliance on a composite endpoint, exclusion of procedural bleeding from the primary safety outcome, and a numerical excess of ischaemic strokes. Overall, CHAMPION-AF represents a shift in risk profile rather than therapeutic equivalence, supporting LAA closure in selected patients rather than as a routine first-line alternative to NOAC therapy.

AI.tldr: CHAMPION-AF 试验显示，在适合长期抗凝的非瓣膜性房颤患者中，Watchman FLX 左心耳封堵在心血管死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞复合终点上不劣于 NOAC，并减少非手术相关出血，但缺血性卒中数值上增多，整体体现风险谱的转换而非治疗等效。
AI.motivation: 左心耳封堵（LAA closure）作为非瓣膜性房颤患者长期口服抗凝的替代策略，其与 NOAC 的头对头比较证据有限。CHAMPION-AF 试验旨在评估 Watchman FLX 装置在适合长期抗凝患者中的疗效与安全性，以明确 LAA 封堵能否作为 NOAC 的常规一线替代。
AI.method: CHAMPION-AF 为随机对照试验，纳入适合长期抗凝的非瓣膜性房颤患者，比较 Watchman FLX 左心耳封堵与 NOAC 治疗。主要终点为心血管死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞的复合终点，采用非劣效性设计；主要安全终点关注非手术相关出血。摘要未报告样本量、具体统计方法及非劣效界值。
AI.result: LAA 封堵在主要复合终点（心血管死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞）上达到非劣效性，并显著减少非手术相关出血。但摘要未报告具体效应量、95% 置信区间及 P 值。此外，缺血性卒中在 LAA 封堵组数值上增多，且主要安全终点未纳入手术相关出血。
AI.conclusion: CHAMPION-AF 表明 LAA 封堵相较于 NOAC 并非治疗等效，而是风险谱的转换：减少出血但可能增加缺血性卒中。结果受限于宽松的非劣效界值、复合终点及安全终点定义，支持在特定患者中选择 LAA 封堵，而非作为 NOAC 的常规一线替代。

title: The Rising Burden of Atrial Fibrillation and Respiratory Failure Mortality in the United States: A 25-Year Nationwide Retrospective Analysis of Death Certificate Data.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) and respiratory failure (RF) frequently co-occur in critically ill patients, but long-term national trends in deaths recording both remain unknown.

METHODS: CDC WONDER multiple-cause-of-death data identified U.S. adults aged ≥ 55 years with both AF (including atrial flutter) and RF listed on death certificates from 1999 to 2024. Age-adjusted mortality rates (AAMRs) and annual percent changes (APCs) were estimated using joinpoint regression. Sensitivity analyses included adults aged ≥ 25 years, exclusion of COVID-19-related deaths, and stratification by co-listed heart failure (HF).

RESULTS: A total of 462 284 deaths listed both AF and RF. The AAMR increased roughly five-fold (7.84 to 41.76 per 100 000), rising steadily through 2018 (APC 7.81), accelerating through 2021 (APC 18.78), and declining thereafter (APC -5.90). Excluding deaths listing COVID-19, the 2018-2021 acceleration was not detected, and AAMRs rose through 2024 (2017-2024 APC 5.25). AAMRs for deaths without HF recorded rose over fourfold. Mean AAMRs were higher in males (26.19) than in females (19.04) and in non-Hispanic (NH) White adults (24.06) than in other groups. The West and nonmetropolitan areas had the highest rates. The 2018-2021 surge was steepest among Hispanic (APC 25.62) and NH Black adults (APC 24.06).

CONCLUSIONS: Population mortality rates for deaths recording both AF and RF increased substantially over 25 years, beginning before the COVID-19 pandemic, persisting after excluding deaths listing COVID-19, and occurring with and without HF recorded. These data cannot separate changes in disease occurrence from changes in diagnosis or coding.

AI.tldr: 美国55岁以上成人中，死亡证明同时记录房颤和呼吸衰竭的年龄调整死亡率在25年间增长约5倍，从7.84升至41.76/10万，且独立于COVID-19和心衰记录。
AI.motivation: 房颤与呼吸衰竭在危重患者中常共存，但两者共同导致死亡的长期全国趋势尚不明确，既往缺乏基于死亡证明的大样本纵向数据。
AI.method: 基于CDC WONDER多死因数据的全国回顾性分析，纳入1999-2024年美国≥55岁死亡证明中同时记录房颤（含房扑）和呼吸衰竭的成人，共462,284例。采用Joinpoint回归估计年龄调整死亡率（AAMR）和年度百分比变化（APC）。敏感性分析包括≥25岁人群、排除COVID-19相关死亡、按是否合并心衰分层。
AI.result: AAMR从7.84升至41.76/10万，增长约5倍。2018年前APC为7.81，2018-2021年加速至APC 18.78，之后下降APC -5.90。排除COVID-19死亡后，2018-2021年加速消失，AAMR持续上升至2024年（2017-2024年APC 5.25）。无心衰记录的死亡AAMR增长超4倍。男性平均AAMR（26.19）高于女性（19.04），非西班牙裔白人（24.06）高于其他组。西部和非都市地区死亡率最高。2018-2021年激增在西班牙裔（APC 25.62）和非西班牙裔黑人（APC 24.06）中最陡峭。
AI.conclusion: 25年来房颤合并呼吸衰竭的死亡率大幅上升，早于COVID-19大流行，排除COVID-19后仍持续，且无论是否记录心衰均存在。该数据无法区分疾病发生与诊断/编码变化，提示需加强房颤患者呼吸系统共病管理及死因编码质量监测。

title: Posterior Pulmonary Vein Isolation Lesion Spacing and Left Atrial Posterior Wall Narrowing During Pulsed Field Ablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Left atrial posterior wall (LAPW) narrowing after excessive extension of bilateral pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) lines during pulsed field ablation (PFA) may create a proarrhythmic substrate. The CARTO 3-integrated variable-loop circular catheter (VLCC) provides real-time tissue proximity indication (TPI) and ablation-tag location, but their relationship with LAPW narrowing remains unclear. Therefore, we evaluated associations of TPI status and inter-tag distance (ITD) with acute LAPW narrowing and whether an ITD-guided workflow was associated with LAPW preservation.

METHODS: Fifty-two retrospective and 27 prospective atrial fibrillation patients underwent PFA using a VLCC. In the retrospective phase, we evaluated the association between ITD, measured using TPI-positive tags and all tags, and LAPW narrowing (< 10 mm) and derived a cutoff. In the prospective phase, the ITD-guided workflow was applied, and we assessed residual LAPW band width.

RESULTS: In the retrospective phase, both TPI-positive-tag ITD and all-tag ITD correlated with LAPW band width (r = 0.63 and 0.70, respectively; both p < 0.001). All-tag ITD showed a numerically higher AUC for LAPW narrowing than TPI-positive-tag ITD (0.869 vs. 0.795; p = 0.099), with an optimal all-tag ITD cutoff of 16.5 mm. In the prospective phase incorporating the all-tag ITD cutoff, residual LAPW band widths were wider at the roof (19.4 ± 7.9 vs. 25.1 ± 7.1 mm; p = 0.002) and carina (13.6 ± 7.1 vs. 20.8 ± 8.0 mm; p < 0.001) than in the retrospective phase.

CONCLUSIONS: An all-tag ITD-guided workflow was associated with greater preservation of the residual LAPW band width.

AI.tldr: 在脉冲场消融中，基于所有消融标记间距（ITD）引导的工作流程可保留更宽的左房后壁残余带宽，减少后壁变窄。
AI.motivation: 双侧肺静脉隔离线过度延伸可能导致左房后壁（LAPW）变窄，形成致心律失常基质。CARTO 3整合的可变环状标测导管（VLCC）提供实时组织接近指示（TPI）和消融标记定位，但其与LAPW变窄的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 研究纳入52例回顾性和27例前瞻性房颤患者，均使用VLCC行脉冲场消融。回顾性阶段评估基于TPI阳性标记和所有标记测量的标记间距（ITD）与LAPW变窄（<10 mm）的关联并推导截断值；前瞻性阶段应用ITD引导的工作流程，评估残余LAPW带宽。
AI.result: 回顾性阶段，TPI阳性标记ITD和所有标记ITD均与LAPW带宽相关（r=0.63和0.70，均p<0.001）。所有标记ITD对LAPW变窄的AUC数值上高于TPI阳性标记ITD（0.869 vs. 0.795；p=0.099），最佳所有标记ITD截断值为16.5 mm。前瞻性阶段应用该截断值后，顶部（19.4±7.9 vs. 25.1±7.1 mm；p=0.002）和隆突（13.6±7.1 vs. 20.8±8.0 mm；p<0.001）的残余LAPW带宽均较回顾性阶段更宽。
AI.conclusion: 基于所有标记ITD引导的工作流程与更好的残余LAPW带宽保留相关，可能减少后壁变窄所致的心律失常基质。需进一步研究验证其长期临床获益。

title: Transient Lung-Volume Reduction Improves First-Shock Cardioversion Success by Reducing Transthoracic Impedance in Patients With Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Transthoracic impedance (TTI) is an important determinant of the efficacy of direct-current cardioversion (DCCV), as increased impedance may reduce myocardial current delivery. Because lung volume influences thoracic electrical properties, transient lung-volume reduction (TLVR) may represent a simple strategy for acutely lowering TTI and improving cardioversion efficacy. This study evaluated the effect of a standardized TLVR maneuver on TTI and first-shock cardioversion success in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation (AF).

METHODS: This prospective, randomized study included 116 patients with persistent AF scheduled for first-time radiofrequency ablation. Patients were randomized 1:1 to conventional mechanical ventilation (standard CV group, n = 58) or a standardized TLVR maneuver immediately before cardioversion (TLVR CV group, n = 58). Baseline TTI was measured before the intervention, and post-TLVR TTI was additionally measured in the TLVR group. All patients underwent anterior-posterior cardioversion with an initial 200 J shock. First-shock success was defined as maintenance of sinus rhythm for at least 1 min. Multivariable linear and hierarchical logistic regression analyses were performed to investigate determinants of impedance reduction and first-shock success.

RESULTS: First-shock cardioversion success was significantly higher in the TLVR CV group than in the standard CV group (53.4% vs. 29.3%, p = 0.008), whereas cumulative success after up to three shocks was similar (96.6% vs. 91.4%, p = 0.242). The impedance reduction rate was significantly higher among patients with successful first-shock cardioversion (9.09% vs. 5.00%, p < 0.001). In multivariable linear regression, TLVR independently increased the impedance reduction rate by 1.75 percentage points (B = 1.751, p = 0.001), while a higher Body Roundness Index was associated with a lower reduction (β = -0.468, p < 0.001). In the mechanistic logistic regression model, each 1% increase in impedance reduction was associated with a 2.23-fold higher likelihood of first-shock success (OR = 2.226, p < 0.001). Model explanatory power increased from 56.3% to 74.9% after the incorporation of impedance reduction.

CONCLUSION: A standardized TLVR maneuver immediately before cardioversion was associated with greater TTI reduction and an approximately twofold increase in first-shock cardioversion success in patients with persistent AF. The impedance reduction rate emerged as a strong independent predictor of successful initial cardioversion, supporting a potential physiological mechanism linking acute lung-volume reduction to improved electrical cardioversion efficacy.

AI.tldr: 在持续性房颤患者中，直流电复律前实施标准化短暂肺容积减少操作可显著降低经胸阻抗，使首次200 J电击复律成功率从29.3%提升至53.4%。
AI.motivation: 经胸阻抗是决定直流电复律能否有效向心肌输送电流的关键因素，阻抗升高会削弱复律效果。肺容积影响胸腔电学特性，但通过短暂减少肺容积来急性降低经胸阻抗、提高复律成功率这一简单策略此前缺乏前瞻性随机证据。
AI.method: 前瞻性随机对照研究，纳入116例拟首次接受射频消融的持续性房颤患者，1:1随机分为常规机械通气组（n=58）与复律前标准化短暂肺容积减少组（n=58）。干预前测基线经胸阻抗，TLVR组另测干预后阻抗。所有患者接受前后位200 J首次电击复律，首次成功定义为窦性心律维持至少1分钟。采用多因素线性回归与分层logistic回归分析阻抗下降及首次成功的决定因素。
AI.result: TLVR组首次电击成功率显著高于常规组（53.4% vs 29.3%，p=0.008），但最多三次电击的累积成功率两组相近（96.6% vs 91.4%，p=0.242）。首次成功者阻抗下降率更高（9.09% vs 5.00%，p<0.001）。多因素线性回归中，TLVR独立使阻抗下降率增加1.75个百分点（B=1.751，p=0.001），而体重圆度指数较高与阻抗下降较少相关（β=-0.468，p<0.001）。机制模型中，阻抗下降率每增加1%，首次成功可能性提高2.23倍（OR=2.226，p<0.001）；纳入阻抗下降率后模型解释力由56.3%升至74.9%。
AI.conclusion: 复律前标准化短暂肺容积减少操作可增强经胸阻抗下降，并使持续性房颤首次电击复律成功率约翻倍；阻抗下降率是首次复律成功的强独立预测因子，提示急性肺容积减少改善电复律疗效的生理机制。该策略操作简单，有望优化电复律流程，但本研究样本量有限、仅在首次消融患者中开展，且对累积成功率无改善，仍需多中心验证。

summary_zh:
背景：经胸阻抗（TTI）是直流电复律（DCCV）疗效的重要决定因素，因为阻抗增加可能减少心肌电流输送。由于肺容积影响胸部电学特性，短暂性肺容积减少（TLVR）可能是一种急性降低TTI并提高复律疗效的简单策略。本研究评估了标准化TLVR操作对持续性心房颤动（AF）患者TTI和首次电击复律成功率的影响。

方法：这项前瞻性随机研究纳入116例计划首次射频消融的持续性AF患者。患者按1：1随机分为常规机械通气组（标准CV组，n=58）或复律前立即进行标准化TLVR操作组（TLVR CV组，n=58）。干预前测量基线TTI，TLVR组额外测量TLVR后TTI。所有患者接受前后位复律，初始电击能量200 J。首次电击成功定义为窦性心律维持至少1分钟。采用多变量线性回归和分层逻辑回归分析探讨阻抗降低和首次电击成功的决定因素。

结果：TLVR CV组首次电击复律成功率显著高于标准CV组（53.4% vs. 29.3%，p=0.008），而最多三次电击后的累积成功率相似（96.6% vs. 91.4%，p=0.242）。首次电击复律成功患者的阻抗降低率显著更高（9.09% vs. 5.00%，p<0.001）。在多变量线性回归中，TLVR独立使阻抗降低率增加1.75个百分点（B=1.751，p=0.001），而较高的身体圆度指数与较低的降低率相关（β=-0.468，p<0.001）。在机制逻辑回归模型中，阻抗降低率每增加1%，首次电击成功的可能性增加2.23倍（OR=2.226，p<0.001）。纳入阻抗降低率后，模型解释力从56.3%提高到74.9%。

结论：复律前立即进行标准化TLVR操作与持续性AF患者更大的TTI降低和首次复律成功率约增加两倍相关。阻抗降低率成为初始复律成功的强独立预测因子，支持急性肺容积减少与电复律疗效改善之间的潜在生理机制。

Changes in circulating biomarkers in symptomatic atrial fibrillation from before to one day after catheter ablation
summary: Abstract Atrial fibrillation (AF) causes debilitating symptoms in some patients, whereas others remain asymptomatic; the biological basis remains unclear. In this prospective case–control study, we investigated whether circulating biomarkers were associated with symptom burden, differed between patients with symptomatic AF and controls, and differed between samples collected before catheter ablation and on the first post-procedural day. We enrolled 100 patients undergoing first-time AF ablation and 100 age- and sex-matched controls; one patient with AF was excluded because of compromised blood samples. Symptoms were assessed using the AF6 questionnaire and EHRA score. Ninety-two proteins were measured using the Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel, and six additional biomarkers were analysed locally. The median AF6 was 23 (IQR 14–32), and 46% had modified EHRA score III. No statistically significant biomarker–symptom associations were detected after Bonferroni correction. In age- and sex-adjusted comparisons, 12 biomarkers differed between patients with AF and controls, including higher NT-proBNP, CCL20, and CXCL10, and lower FGF-19. On the first post-procedural day, 51 biomarkers differed significantly from pre-procedural levels, with the largest increases observed for hs-TnI, IL-6, and hs-CRP. These findings demonstrate biomarker differences between AF patients and controls and an acute post-procedural response consistent with myocardial injury and inflammation. Clinical trial registration: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05201989 09/01/2022.

AI.tldr: 房颤患者与对照者存在12种循环生物标志物差异，导管消融术后第一天51种标志物显著变化，提示急性心肌损伤和炎症反应，但生物标志物与症状负担无关。
AI.motivation: 房颤患者症状负担差异的生物学基础尚不明确，循环生物标志物是否与症状相关、是否在消融术后急性期发生变化尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 前瞻性病例对照研究，纳入100例首次房颤消融患者和100例年龄性别匹配对照，排除1例血样不合格患者。用AF6问卷和EHRA评分评估症状，Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel检测92种蛋白，另局部检测6种标志物。比较生物标志物与症状的关联、患者与对照的差异以及消融术前与术后第一天的变化，采用Bonferroni校正。
AI.result: AF6中位数23（IQR 14–32），46%患者改良EHRA为III级。Bonferroni校正后未发现生物标志物与症状显著相关。年龄性别校正后，12种生物标志物在房颤患者与对照间有差异，包括NT-proBNP、CCL20、CXCL10升高和FGF-19降低。消融术后第一天51种生物标志物较术前显著变化，hs-TnI、IL-6和hs-CRP升高最明显。
AI.conclusion: 房颤患者存在特定循环生物标志物谱改变，消融术后急性期出现与心肌损伤和炎症一致的反应，但生物标志物与症状负担无关。研究提示症状的生物学机制可能更复杂，需进一步探索；局限性包括单中心、样本量有限和仅短期随访。

summary_zh: 摘要 心房颤动（AF）在部分患者中引起使人衰弱的症状，而另一些患者则保持无症状；其生物学基础仍不清楚。在这项前瞻性病例对照研究中，我们探讨了循环生物标志物是否与症状负担相关、在有症状的AF患者与对照者之间是否存在差异，以及导管消融前与术后第一天采集的样本之间是否存在差异。我们纳入了100例接受首次AF消融的患者和100例年龄、性别匹配的对照者；1例AF患者因血样不合格被排除。症状采用AF6问卷和EHRA评分评估。使用Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel检测92种蛋白，并在本地额外分析6种生物标志物。AF6中位数为23（IQR 14–32），46%的患者改良EHRA评分为III级。经Bonferroni校正后，未检测到生物标志物与症状之间具有统计学显著性的关联。在年龄和性别校正的比较中，12种生物标志物在AF患者与对照者之间存在差异，包括NT-proBNP、CCL20和CXCL10较高，FGF-19较低。在术后第一天，51种生物标志物与术前水平存在显著差异，其中hs-TnI、IL-6和hs-CRP的升高幅度最大。这些发现表明AF患者与对照者之间存在生物标志物差异，并且术后出现与心肌损伤和炎症一致的急性反应。临床试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05201989 09/01/2022。

title: Can the QTc interval and T-wave morphology change intermittently in arrhythmogenic mitral valve prolapse? First paediatric case experience.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Mitral valve prolapse is typically considered a benign condition. However, a newly described repolarisation anomaly known as arrhythmogenic mitral valve prolapse syndrome is closely associated with repolarisation disturbances and can potentially lead to sudden cardiac death. Arrhythmogenic mitral valve prolapse syndrome is characterised by bileaflet mitral valve prolapse, mitral valve regurgitation, T-wave inversions in the inferolateral leads, and complex ventricular ectopy.

CASE REPORT: In this case, we present the diagnosis of arrhythmogenic mitral valve prolapse syndrome in a 16-year-old adolescent girl who experienced sudden cardiac arrest during exercise. Her electrocardiograms revealed intermittent QT/QTc prolongation. Interestingly, QT prolongation was always associated with T wave inversion in inferolateral leads. Heterozygous genomic changes were detected in the KCNH2 gene and the 25th exon of the ANK2 gene. These findings support the diagnosis of arrhythmogenic mitral valve prolapse syndrome in this patient.

CONCLUSIONS: Since mitral valve prolapse is a common condition in the society, it is important to determine beforehand which ones are at risk of sudden death. As these boundaries are drawn better, underdiagnosis as well as overdiagnosis will be prevented.

AI.tldr: 16岁女孩运动时心脏骤停，确诊致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂综合征，心电图示间歇性QTc延长且总伴下侧壁T波倒置，基因检测发现KCNH2和ANK2变异。
AI.motivation: 二尖瓣脱垂通常被认为良性，但新描述的致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂综合征与复极异常和心脏性猝死相关，目前缺乏儿科病例经验，需识别高危患者以避免漏诊和过度诊断。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为16岁青少年女性，运动时发生心脏骤停。收集心电图（观察QT/QTc及T波形态变化）并进行基因检测。未报告样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 心电图显示间歇性QT/QTc延长，且QT延长总是与下侧壁导联T波倒置同时出现。基因检测发现KCNH2基因杂合变异及ANK2基因第25外显子杂合变异。摘要未报告具体QTc数值、变异细节及随访结果。
AI.conclusion: 本病例支持致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂综合征可在儿科患者中表现为心脏骤停，间歇性QTc延长伴下侧壁T波倒置可能是警示信号，基因变异（KCNH2、ANK2）支持诊断。临床意义在于对二尖瓣脱垂患者应评估猝死风险，但单病例报告局限性明显，需更多研究明确高危边界。

summary_zh:
背景：二尖瓣脱垂通常被认为是一种良性疾病。然而，一种新近被描述的复极异常，称为致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂综合征，与复极障碍密切相关，并可能导致心源性猝死。致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂综合征的特征是双叶二尖瓣脱垂、二尖瓣反流、下侧壁导联T波倒置和复杂室性异位搏动。

病例报告：在本病例中，我们介绍了一名16岁青春期女孩在运动期间发生心脏骤停后诊断为致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂综合征。她的心电图显示间歇性QT/QTc延长。有趣的是，QT延长总是与下侧壁导联T波倒置相关。在KCNH2基因和ANK2基因第25外显子中检测到杂合基因组改变。这些发现支持该患者致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂综合征的诊断。

结论：由于二尖瓣脱垂在社会中是一种常见疾病，因此事先确定哪些人有猝死风险非常重要。随着这些界限被更好地划定，将可防止诊断不足和过度诊断。

title: Deep-neural-network-assisted wavefront detection for the elimination of spiral-wave turbulence in cardiac-tissue models.
summary: Ventricular arrhythmias, like ventricular tachycardia (VT) and ventricular fibrillation (VF), precipitate sudden cardiac death, which is the leading cause of mortality in the industrialized world. Thus, the elimination of VT and VF is a problem of paramount importance, which is studied experimentally, theoretically, and numerically. Numerical studies use partial-differential-equation models, for cardiac tissue, which admit solutions with spiral- or broken-spiral-wave solutions that are the mathematical counterparts of VT and VF. In silico investigations of such mathematical models of cardiac tissue allow us not only to explore the properties of such spiral-wave turbulence, but also to develop mathematical analogs of low-amplitude defibrillation by the application of currents that can eliminate spiral waves. We develop an efficient deep-neural-network based method for the control of spiral-wave turbulence in mathematical models of cardiac tissue. Specifically, we use the simple, two-variable Aliev-Panfilov and the ionically realistic TP06 mathematical models to show that the lower the correlation length ξ for spiral-turbulence patterns, the easier it is to eliminate them by the application of control currents on a mesh electrode. We then use spiral-turbulence patterns from the TP06 model to train a U-Net to predict the sodium current, which is most prominent along thin lines that track the propagating front of a spiral wave. We apply currents, in the vicinities of the predicted sodium-current lines to eliminate spiral waves efficiently. The amplitudes of these currents are adjusted automatically so that they are small when ξ is large and vice versa.

AI.tldr: 在Aliev-Panfilov和TP06心脏组织模型中，螺旋波湍流的相关长度ξ越小越易被控制电流消除；基于U-Net预测钠电流线并施加自动调整幅值的电流可高效消除螺旋波。
AI.motivation: 室性心动过速（VT）和心室颤动（VF）是心源性猝死的主要原因，其数学模型对应螺旋波或破碎螺旋波。既往在计算机模拟中探索低幅度除颤的数学类似物，但缺乏高效、自动化的控制方法，尤其是如何利用深度学习优化电流施加策略尚不明确。
AI.method: 本研究为计算仿真研究，采用双变量Aliev-Panfilov模型和离子真实型TP06心脏组织模型，生成螺旋波湍流图案。以相关长度ξ量化湍流复杂度，在网格电极上施加控制电流。利用TP06模型的螺旋波湍流图案训练U-Net预测钠电流（沿螺旋波传播前沿的细线分布），并在预测的钠电流线附近施加电流，电流幅值根据ξ自动调整（ξ大时幅值小，ξ小时幅值大）。主要终点为螺旋波消除效率，摘要未报告具体样本量及统计检验方法。
AI.result: 在两种模型中，螺旋波湍流图案的相关长度ξ越低，通过网格电极施加控制电流越容易消除。U-Net能有效预测钠电流线，在预测线附近施加自动调整幅值的电流可高效消除螺旋波；电流幅值随ξ增大而减小、随ξ减小而增大。摘要未报告消除成功率、电流幅值具体数值及P值。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习辅助的波前检测可指导低幅度电流精准施加，实现螺旋波湍流的高效消除，为VT/VF的数学除颤策略提供了新思路。但研究仅基于数学模型，尚未在真实心脏组织或临床中验证，且缺乏与传统方法的定量比较，临床转化需进一步研究。

summary_zh: 室性心律失常，如室性心动过速（VT）和心室颤动（VF），会导致心源性猝死，这是工业化国家的主要死亡原因。因此，消除VT和VF是一个至关重要的问题，已通过实验、理论和数值方法进行研究。数值研究使用心脏组织的偏微分方程模型，这些模型允许存在螺旋波或破碎螺旋波解，它们是VT和VF的数学对应物。对这类心脏组织数学模型的计算研究不仅使我们能够探索这种螺旋波湍流的特性，还能开发低振幅除颤的数学模拟方法，即通过施加电流来消除螺旋波。我们开发了一种基于深度神经网络的高效方法，用于控制心脏组织数学模型中的螺旋波湍流。具体而言，我们使用简单的两变量Aliev-Panfilov模型和离子逼真的TP06数学模型来表明，螺旋湍流模式的相关长度ξ越小，通过在网格电极上施加控制电流就越容易消除它们。然后，我们使用TP06模型中的螺旋湍流模式来训练U-Net以预测钠电流，该电流在追踪螺旋波传播前沿的细线附近最为突出。我们在预测的钠电流线附近施加电流，以高效消除螺旋波。这些电流的振幅自动调整，使得当ξ大时电流小，反之亦然。

title: Developing a case management program and clinical practice for high-risk sudden cardiac death patients through the lens of family systems theory.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: To develop a case management plan for patients at high risk of sudden cardiac death (SCD) from the perspective of family systems theory and evaluate its clinical practice effects.

METHODS: By using the random sampling method, 100 patients at high risk of SCD who visited our hospital from March 2025 to June 2025 were selected as the research subjects. They were randomly divided into an experimental group (n = 50) and a control group (n = 50). The control group received routine care and follow-up, while the experimental group implemented a case management plan based on the family systems theory, with both interventions lasting for one year. Both groups were evaluated at baseline and endpoint using disease cognition assessments, the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9), Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7), Tampa Scale for Kinesiophobia Heart (TSK-SV Heart), General Self-Efficacy Scale (GSES), Family APGAR, and Major Adverse Cardiac Events (MACE).

RESULTS: There were no statistically significant differences in baseline data between the two groups (P > 0.05). After the intervention, the experimental group showed significantly better scores in disease cognition, PHQ-9, GAD-7, TSK-SV Heart, GSES, APGAR, and MACE compared to the control group (P < 0.05).

CONCLUSION: The case management plan for high-risk SCD patients based on family systems theory is scientifically sound and feasible. It can effectively reduce anxiety and depression, alleviate kinesiophobia, improve disease cognition, and promote family care, thereby improving the patients' quality of life and prognosis.

AI.tldr: 基于家庭系统理论的个案管理方案可改善SCD高危患者的疾病认知、焦虑抑郁、运动恐惧及家庭关怀，并降低MACE。
AI.motivation: SCD高危患者常伴心理负担与家庭支持不足，既往常规随访模式对心理社会因素干预有限，缺乏基于家庭系统理论的系统化管理方案及临床验证证据。
AI.method: 随机对照研究，纳入2025年3月至6月就诊的SCD高危患者100例，随机分为实验组（n=50，家庭系统理论个案管理）与对照组（n=50，常规护理随访），干预1年；基线及终点评估疾病认知、PHQ-9、GAD-7、TSK-SV Heart、GSES、Family APGAR及MACE；统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 两组基线资料无统计学差异（P>0.05）。干预后实验组疾病认知、PHQ-9、GAD-7、TSK-SV Heart、GSES、APGAR及MACE评分均显著优于对照组（P<0.05）；具体效应量及95%CI摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该方案科学可行，可减轻焦虑抑郁、缓解运动恐惧、改善疾病认知与家庭关怀，从而改善生活质量和预后；但单中心小样本、统计细节缺失，需多中心验证。

summary_zh:
目的：从家庭系统理论的角度为心脏性猝死（SCD）高危患者制定个案管理方案，并评估其临床实践效果。

方法：采用随机抽样方法，选取2025年3月至2025年6月期间就诊于我院的100例SCD高危患者作为研究对象。将其随机分为实验组（n = 50）和对照组（n = 50）。对照组接受常规护理和随访，实验组实施基于家庭系统理论的个案管理方案，两组干预均持续一年。两组均在基线和终点时使用疾病认知评估、患者健康问卷-9（PHQ-9）、广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7（GAD-7）、坦帕运动恐惧症量表心脏版（TSK-SV Heart）、一般自我效能感量表（GSES）、家庭APGAR量表以及主要不良心脏事件（MACE）进行评估。

结果：两组基线资料差异无统计学意义（P > 0.05）。干预后，实验组在疾病认知、PHQ-9、GAD-7、TSK-SV Heart、GSES、APGAR和MACE方面的评分均显著优于对照组（P < 0.05）。

结论：基于家庭系统理论的SCD高危患者个案管理方案科学合理且可行。该方案能有效减轻焦虑和抑郁，缓解运动恐惧症，改善疾病认知，促进家庭照护，从而改善患者的生活质量和预后。

title: GCTRNet: global context-gated temporal refinement for short-window ECG-based premature ventricular contraction detection.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) are one of the most prevalent ventricular arrhythmias and therefore require a method for reliably identifying PVCs from short ECG strips, through an automated system capable of identifying PVCs and evaluating the burden of PVCs. While technology continues to advance, automatic identification of PVCs from very short ECG recordings remains problematic due to significant variability in PVC morphology across various patients as a result of the limited amount of information available from ECG data.

METHODS: To overcome this difficulty, the Global Context-Gated Temporal Refinement (GCTR) module has been created which enhances bidirectional long short-term memory (BLSTM) representations by incorporating segment-level contextual information using context gating and residual learning. The GCTR module was integrated into a convolutional network architecture termed GCTRNet. GCTRNet was evaluated on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database using a patient-independent partition. The frozen model was further evaluated on a predefined subset of CPSC2021 comprising 210 recordings from 105 patients.

RESULTS: The frozen seed-2024 model of GCTRNet, when tested on MITDB data, reached an accuracy of 99.65%, a sensitivity of 96.82% and a specificity of 99.91%. The same frozen model achieved performance on the CPSC2021 subset with 97.83% accuracy, 84.75% sensitivity, and 98.11% specificity and an AUPRC of 80.49%. In addition, GCTRNet outperformed matched comparison models based on BLSTM architecture in many metrics of evaluation, thus supporting the potential of the temporal refinement method proposed.

CONCLUSIONS: GCTRNet provides an effective temporal refinement approach for patient-independent short-window PVC detection and shows potential for cross-database application.

AI.tldr: GCTRNet在短窗心电图上检测室性早搏，MIT-BIH数据库准确率99.65%、敏感度96.82%，跨库CPSC2021子集准确率97.83%、敏感度84.75%。
AI.motivation: 室性早搏（PVC）是最常见的室性心律失常之一，需要能从短心电图片段可靠自动识别PVC并评估负荷的方法；但因患者间PVC形态差异大且短记录信息有限，自动识别仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出全局上下文门控时间精炼（GCTR）模块，通过上下文门控和残差学习将片段级上下文信息融入双向长短期记忆网络（BLSTM）表示，构建卷积网络GCTRNet。在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库上采用患者独立划分评估，并将冻结模型在CPSC2021预设子集（105例患者、210条记录）上进一步验证。
AI.result: 冻结的seed-2024模型在MITDB上准确率99.65%、敏感度96.82%、特异度99.91%；在CPSC2021子集上准确率97.83%、敏感度84.75%、特异度98.11%、AUPRC 80.49%。GCTRNet在多项评价指标上优于基于BLSTM架构的匹配对照模型。
AI.conclusion: GCTRNet为患者独立的短窗PVC检测提供了有效的时间精炼方法，并显示出跨数据库应用潜力；但摘要未报告前瞻性临床验证及PVC负荷评估的具体结果，其临床推广仍需进一步研究。

背景：室性早搏（PVCs）是最常见的室性心律失常之一，因此需要一种能够从短心电图片段中可靠识别PVCs的方法，通过一个能够识别PVCs并评估PVC负荷的自动化系统。尽管技术不断进步，但由于不同患者间PVC形态的显著变异性以及心电图数据可用信息量有限，从极短心电图记录中自动识别PVCs仍然存在问题。

方法：为克服这一困难，创建了全局上下文门控时间细化（GCTR）模块，该模块通过使用上下文门控和残差学习整合片段级上下文信息来增强双向长短期记忆（BLSTM）表示。GCTR模块被整合到一个称为GCTRNet的卷积网络架构中。GCTRNet在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库上使用患者独立分区进行了评估。冻结模型进一步在CPSC2021的预定义子集上进行了评估，该子集包含来自105名患者的210条记录。

结果：GCTRNet的冻结种子2024模型在MITDB数据上测试时，达到了99.65%的准确率、96.82%的灵敏度和99.91%的特异性。同一冻结模型在CPSC2021子集上取得了97.83%的准确率、84.75%的灵敏度和98.11%的特异性，AUPRC为80.49%。此外，GCTRNet在许多评估指标上优于基于BLSTM架构的匹配比较模型，从而支持了所提出的时间细化方法的潜力。

结论：GCTRNet为患者独立的短窗口PVC检测提供了一种有效的时间细化方法，并显示出跨数据库应用的潜力。

title: Validation of a Four-Extrastimulus Ventricular Stimulation Protocol for Arrhythmic Risk Stratification in Tetralogy of Fallot.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Risk stratification for sustained ventricular arrhythmias (SVA) in adults with repaired Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) remains challenging. Although programmed ventricular stimulation (PVS) has shown a high negative predictive value, the prognostic performance of a four-extrastimulus PVS protocol-validated in ischemic heart disease-has not been systematically evaluated in congenital heart disease.

METHODS AND RESULTS: We retrospectively included 41 consecutive adults with repaired TOF who underwent EPS using a standardized four-extrastimulus PVS protocol at two right ventricular sites. Inducibility of SVA was assessed. The primary endpoint was the occurrence of clinical SVA during follow-up. Kaplan-Meier analysis and Firth-penalized Cox regression were used to evaluate prognostic performance, and diagnostic accuracy metrics were calculated. Inducibility was observed in 18 patients (44%). During a median follow-up of 1.68 years, SVA occurred exclusively in inducible patients (5/18; 28%), all corresponding to sustained monomorphic ventricular tachycardia. No non-inducible patient developed SVA. Inducibility was associated with significantly lower SVA-free survival (log-rank p = 0.015) and an increased risk of events (HR 13.6; 95% CI 1.5-1804; p = 0.017) in univariate analysis. The four-extrastimulus protocol demonstrated a sensitivity of 100% and specificity of 64%.

CONCLUSIONS: In adults with repaired TOF and risk factors for sudden cardiac death, the four-extrastimulus PVS protocol identified a subgroup at high arrhythmic risk while reliably excluding events in non-inducible individuals. These findings support the potential value of PVS as part of multimodal risk stratification, particularly for identifying patients in whom ICD implantation may be deferred.

AI.tldr: 在修复后法洛四联症成人中，四额外刺激PVS方案可诱发SVA者占44%，随访期间仅诱发者发生SVA，阴性预测价值高。
AI.motivation: 修复后法洛四联症成人发生持续性室性心律失常（SVA）的风险分层仍具挑战。程序性心室刺激（PVS）虽阴性预测价值高，但四额外刺激方案（已在缺血性心脏病中验证）在先天性心脏病中尚未系统评估。
AI.method: 回顾性纳入41例连续修复后TOF成人，均接受标准化四额外刺激PVS方案（两个右室部位）。评估SVA可诱发性。主要终点为随访期间临床SVA发生。采用Kaplan-Meier分析和Firth惩罚Cox回归评估预后性能，并计算诊断准确性指标。
AI.result: 18例（44%）可诱发SVA。中位随访1.68年，SVA仅发生于可诱发患者（5/18，28%），均为持续性单形性室速；不可诱发者无SVA发生。可诱发性与显著降低的无SVA生存率相关（log-rank P=0.015），单因素分析中事件风险增加（HR 13.6；95% CI 1.5-1804；P=0.017）。四额外刺激方案敏感性100%，特异性64%。
AI.conclusion: 在具有心脏性猝死危险因素的修复后TOF成人中，四额外刺激PVS方案可识别高心律失常风险亚组，并可靠排除不可诱发者的事件。这些发现支持PVS作为多模式风险分层的一部分，尤其有助于识别可推迟ICD植入的患者。

title: Predicting in-silico ventricular tachycardia induction on fuzzy cardiac digital twins.
summary: Ventricular tachycardia (VT) is a leading cause of sudden cardiac death (SCD). To date, clinical VT risk assessment is either inaccurate, invasive or expensive. Patient-specific computer modeling of heart electrophysiology (EP) is a promising non-invasive risk assessment approach. It has three major limitations: computational cost, inaccurate arrhythmogenic substrate geometry and unknown patient-specific tissue EP properties. We present a pacing outcome predictor (POP) that quickly identifies the conditions needed to induce VT in three-dimensional personalized cardiac computer models. The POP is used to test VT induction across multiple model versions of a patient, covering scar geometry and EP property variations, with an added layer of model reduction to further accelerate calculations. The results are combined into a personalized VT risk metric based on in-silico VT inducibility across the patient's models. In a retrospective 10-patient repaired Tetralogy of Fallot cohort, the metric showed complete separation (10/10) between patients with and without clinically inducible VT, suggesting potential for non-invasive VT risk assessment in this population.

AI.tldr: 基于模糊心脏数字孪生的起搏结局预测器在10例法洛四联症修复术后患者中完全区分了临床可诱导与不可诱导VT的患者（10/10）。
AI.motivation: 室性心动过速（VT）是心源性猝死的主要原因，现有临床风险评估不准确、有创或昂贵。患者特异性心脏电生理计算模型有望实现无创风险评估，但受限于计算成本高、致心律失常基质几何不准确和患者组织电生理特性未知。
AI.method: 研究提出起搏结局预测器（POP），在三维个性化心脏计算机模型中快速识别诱导VT所需条件，并测试同一患者多个模型版本（覆盖瘢痕几何和电生理特性变异），结合模型降阶加速计算。基于患者模型集合的VT可诱导性构建个性化VT风险指标。回顾性纳入10例法洛四联症修复术后患者，评估该指标对临床可诱导VT的区分能力。
AI.result: 在10例法洛四联症修复术后患者中，该风险指标完全区分了临床可诱导VT与不可诱导VT的患者（10/10）。摘要未报告效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 基于模糊心脏数字孪生的VT风险指标在该小样本队列中显示出完全区分能力，提示其作为法洛四联症修复术后患者无创VT风险评估工具的潜力。但样本量小、回顾性设计，需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 室性心动过速（VT）是心源性猝死（SCD）的主要原因之一。迄今为止，临床VT风险评估要么不准确，要么有创，要么费用高昂。患者个体化心脏电生理（EP）计算机建模是一种有前景的无创风险评估方法。它存在三个主要局限：计算成本、致心律失常基质几何形状不准确以及患者个体化组织EP特性未知。我们提出一种起搏结局预测器（POP），可在三维个体化心脏计算机模型中快速识别诱导VT所需的条件。POP用于在患者的多个模型版本中测试VT诱导，涵盖瘢痕几何形状和EP特性变异，并增加一层模型降阶以进一步加速计算。结果被整合为基于患者各模型中计算机模拟VT可诱导性的个体化VT风险指标。在一个回顾性10例法洛四联症修复术后患者队列中，该指标在临床可诱导VT与不可诱导VT的患者之间显示出完全分离（10/10），提示在该人群中用于无创VT风险评估的潜力。

title: Coronary stent fixation of left ventricular lead during CRT-D implantation: a case series of three patients.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate a salvage method using coronary stent fixation of the left ventricular (LV) lead to manage refractory LV lead dislodgement caused by unfavorable coronary venous anatomy during cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator (CRT-D) implantation, and to evaluate its technical feasibility and clinical value.

METHODS: We retrospectively included three patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) at our center who developed LV lead dislodgement during or early after CRT-D implantation. Conventional methods failed to maintain a stable lead position. A sirolimus-eluting coronary stent was deployed within the target coronary vein to achieve mechanical anchoring of the LV lead via gentle compression against the venous wall. Procedural details, perioperative complications, and follow-up data were collected and analyzed.

RESULTS: All three patients completed stent fixation of the LV lead. No acute severe complications, such as coronary venous rupture, pericardial tamponade, or lead conductor damage, occurred intraoperatively. No significant change in pacing threshold was observed before and after stent deployment. Cases 1 and 2 were followed for 30 and 26 months, respectively, and lead parameters remained stable. Case 3 was followed for only 2 months and then lost to follow-up; lead parameters were stable at that time point. No clinically meaningful improvement in LV ejection fraction (LVEF) was observed in Cases 1 and 2 during follow-up. Because Case 3 was followed for only 2 months, shorter than the usual 6-12-month window for assessing CRT reverse remodeling, functional response could not be evaluated. This procedure constitutes off-label device use; after full stent deployment, the lead position cannot be readjusted. If device-related infection occurs, transvenous lead extraction may be difficult and uncertain, and surgical removal may be required.

CONCLUSIONS: After all conventional methods have failed, stent fixation may serve as a salvage option for refractory LV lead dislodgement caused by unfavorable coronary venous anatomy. This report describes the clinical observations of sirolimus-eluting stent use in this off-label salvage procedure and details the relevant procedural parameters and techniques. However, the sample size is small, and potential long-term risks, including stent fracture, lead insulation damage, and stability of lead electrical parameters, require further evaluation in larger studies. This technique only addresses the mechanical fixation of the lead and does not guarantee functional benefit from CRT.

AI.tldr: 对3例CRT-D植入中因冠状静脉解剖不佳导致左室导线脱位的患者，采用西罗莫司洗脱支架固定导线，技术可行且短期参数稳定，但LVEF无改善。
AI.motivation: CRT-D植入时，冠状静脉解剖不理想可导致左室导线反复脱位，传统方法难以维持稳定位置，需要探索补救固定技术。
AI.method: 回顾性病例系列，纳入3例HFrEF患者，在CRT-D植入术中或术后早期发生左室导线脱位且传统方法失败。于目标冠状静脉内植入西罗莫司洗脱支架，通过轻微压迫静脉壁机械锚定导线。收集手术细节、围术期并发症及随访数据。
AI.result: 3例均完成支架固定，术中无冠状静脉破裂、心包填塞或导线导体损伤等急性严重并发症，支架释放前后起搏阈值无显著变化。病例1和2分别随访30和26个月，导线参数稳定；病例3随访2个月后失访，当时参数稳定。病例1和2随访期间LVEF无临床意义改善；病例3随访仅2个月，无法评估功能反应。
AI.conclusion: 在传统方法均失败后，支架固定可作为冠状静脉解剖不佳所致难治性左室导线脱位的补救选择，但属超说明书使用，支架完全释放后导线位置无法调整，感染时经静脉拔除困难。样本量小，长期风险（支架断裂、导线绝缘损伤、参数稳定性）需更大研究评估，且该技术仅解决机械固定，不保证CRT功能获益。

summary_zh:
目的：探讨在心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）植入过程中，采用冠状动脉支架固定左心室（LV）导线，以处理因冠状静脉解剖条件不佳导致的难治性LV导线脱位的补救方法，并评估其技术可行性和临床价值。

方法：我们回顾性纳入本中心三例射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）患者，这些患者在CRT-D植入术中或术后早期出现LV导线脱位。常规方法未能维持导线位置稳定。在目标冠状静脉内植入西罗莫司洗脱冠状动脉支架，通过轻柔压迫静脉壁实现LV导线的机械锚定。收集并分析手术细节、围术期并发症及随访数据。

结果：所有三例患者均完成了LV导线的支架固定。术中未发生急性严重并发症，如冠状静脉破裂、心包填塞或导线导体损伤。支架植入前后起搏阈值未见显著变化。病例1和病例2分别随访30个月和26个月，导线参数保持稳定。病例3仅随访2个月后失访；当时导线参数稳定。病例1和病例2在随访期间未观察到左心室射血分数（LVEF）有临床意义的改善。由于病例3仅随访2个月，短于评估CRT逆重构的常规6-12个月窗口，无法评估功能反应。该操作属于器械超说明书使用；支架完全释放后，导线位置无法重新调整。若发生器械相关感染，经静脉导线拔除可能困难且不确定，可能需要外科取出。

结论：在所有常规方法均失败后，支架固定可作为因冠状静脉解剖条件不佳导致的难治性LV导线脱位的补救选择。本报告描述了西莫罗司洗脱支架在此超说明书补救操作中使用的临床观察，并详述了相关手术参数和技术。然而，样本量小，潜在长期风险，包括支架断裂、导线绝缘层损伤和导线电参数稳定性，需要在更大规模的研究中进一步评估。该技术仅解决导线的机械固定问题，并不保证CRT的功能获益。

title: Dissociation between structural reverse remodeling and clinical outcomes in ischemic cardiomyopathy undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy: a real-world analysis.
summary: Patients with non-ischemic cardiomyopathy (NICM) generally exhibit better responses to cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) due to more pronounced reverse remodeling compared to ischemic cardiomyopathy (ICM) patients. However, the prognostic impact of CRT in ICM patients remains uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of heart failure (HF) etiology on reverse remodeling, clinical outcomes, and survival following CRT in a real-world population. We conducted a retrospective observational study including patients who underwent CRT-P (pacing)/CRT-D (defibrillator) implantation. Patients were stratified according to HF etiology (ICM vs. NICM). The primary composite endpoint was the occurrence of all-cause mortality and HF hospitalization. Secondary outcomes focused on echocardiographic measures of left ventricular reverse remodeling. Survival analysis was performed using Kaplan-Meier curves and Cox regression models. Of the 95 patients initially screened, 83 were included in the final analysis, of whom 38 (45.8%) had ICM. The mean age was 69.5±10.4 years, and 75.8% were male. Both groups received similar medical therapy. NICM patients demonstrated a significant improvement in reverse remodeling after CRT [left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF): 32.3±11.5% to 44.0±13.2%, p=0.001); end-diastolic volume (LVEDV): 189.6±74.3 mL to 143.9±48.9 mL, p=0.010] with post-CRT LVEF being higher than in ICM patients (44.0±13.2% vs. 35.5±13.5%, p=0.003). NICM patients were more likely to be super-responders (58.1% vs. 25.0%, p=0.014). No significant differences were observed between groups in the primary composite endpoint (27.3% vs. 42.1%, p=0.171) or overall survival over a mean follow-up of 35 months (log-rank p=0.733). Although ICM patients showed less pronounced reverse remodeling following CRT, long-term clinical outcomes and survival were comparable to those observed in NICM. These findings reinforce the role of CRT as a disease-modifying therapy that prevents disease progression irrespective of HF etiology and support its systematic use in all eligible patients.

AI.tldr: 在真实世界人群中，缺血性心肌病患者接受CRT后左室逆重构程度低于非缺血性心肌病，但全因死亡与心衰住院复合终点及总体生存率无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 非缺血性心肌病（NICM）患者对心脏再同步治疗（CRT）的反应通常优于缺血性心肌病（ICM）患者，表现为更显著的左室逆重构；然而，ICM患者接受CRT的预后影响尚不明确，本研究旨在评估心衰病因对CRT后逆重构、临床结局及生存的影响。
AI.method: 回顾性观察性研究，纳入接受CRT-P或CRT-D植入的患者，按心衰病因分为ICM组与NICM组。主要复合终点为全因死亡和心衰住院，次要终点为超声心动图评估的左室逆重构指标。采用Kaplan-Meier曲线和Cox回归模型进行生存分析。共筛查95例，最终分析83例，其中ICM 38例（45.8%），平均年龄69.5±10.4岁，男性占75.8%。
AI.result: NICM组CRT后左室射血分数（LVEF）从32.3±11.5%显著提高至44.0±13.2%（p=0.001），左室舒张末期容积（LVEDV）从189.6±74.3 mL降至143.9±48.9 mL（p=0.010）；CRT后NICM组LVEF高于ICM组（44.0±13.2% vs. 35.5±13.5%，p=0.003）。NICM组超反应者比例更高（58.1% vs. 25.0%，p=0.014）。两组主要复合终点发生率（27.3% vs. 42.1%，p=0.171）及平均随访35个月的总体生存率（log-rank p=0.733）均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 尽管ICM患者CRT后逆重构程度较轻，但其长期临床结局和生存率与NICM患者相当。这支持CRT作为疾病修饰治疗可延缓疾病进展，且不受心衰病因影响，支持在所有符合适应证的患者中系统应用。本研究为回顾性、单中心、样本量有限，结论需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 非缺血性心肌病（NICM）患者通常对心脏再同步治疗（CRT）表现出更好的反应，因为与缺血性心肌病（ICM）患者相比，其逆转重构更为显著。然而，CRT在ICM患者中的预后影响仍不确定。本研究旨在评估在真实世界人群中，心力衰竭（HF）病因对CRT后逆转重构、临床结局和生存的影响。我们进行了一项回顾性观察性研究，纳入接受CRT-P（起搏）/CRT-D（除颤）植入的患者。患者根据HF病因（ICM vs. NICM）进行分层。主要复合终点是全因死亡和HF住院的发生。次要结局侧重于左心室逆转重构的超声心动图测量。使用Kaplan-Meier曲线和Cox回归模型进行生存分析。在最初筛查的95例患者中，83例纳入最终分析，其中38例（45.8%）患有ICM。平均年龄为69.5±10.4岁，75.8%为男性。两组接受的药物治疗相似。NICM患者在CRT后逆转重构显著改善[左心室射血分数（LVEF）：32.3±11.5%至44.0±13.2%，p=0.001）；舒张末期容积（LVEDV）：189.6±74.3 mL至143.9±48.9 mL，p=0.010]，CRT后LVEF高于ICM患者（44.0±13.2% vs. 35.5±13.5%，p=0.003）。NICM患者更可能成为超级反应者（58.1% vs. 25.0%，p=0.014）。在平均35个月的随访中，两组在主要复合终点（27.3% vs. 42.1%，p=0.171）或总生存率（log-rank p=0.733）方面未观察到显著差异。尽管ICM患者在CRT后逆转重构不那么显著，但长期临床结局和生存与NICM患者相当。这些发现强化了CRT作为一种疾病修饰治疗的作用，无论HF病因如何都能预防疾病进展，并支持在所有符合条件的患者中系统使用。

title: Concomitant Aveir AR and Micra AV2 Hybrid Leadless Implantation During Infected Pacemaker Extraction.
summary: Leadless pacing is an important option for patients with device-related infections. In those requiring dual-chamber support, reduced atrial battery longevity due to continuous implant-to-implant (i2i) communication remains a concern. While recent software updates now allow for the disablement of i2i communication when clinically appropriate, this mode does not provide atrioventricular synchronous pacing. We describe a case of a hybrid leadless system combining an atrial leadless pacemaker (Aveir AR, Abbott) and a second leadless pacemaker capable of atrial mechanical-sensed ventricular pacing (Micra AV2, Medtronic) in the setting of extraction of an infected transvenous pacemaker, providing atrial pacing with ventricular backup capability while preserving atrial device longevity.

AI.tldr: 在感染起搏器拔除术中，联合植入Aveir AR与Micra AV2无导线起搏器，实现心房起搏伴心室备份，同时保留心房设备电池寿命。
AI.motivation: 无导线起搏是器械相关感染患者的重要选择，但双腔支持时持续植入物间通信会缩短心房电池寿命，且关闭通信后无法提供房室同步起搏，临床需要兼顾同步性与电池寿命的方案。
AI.method: 病例报告。在感染经静脉起搏器拔除背景下，植入混合无导线系统：心房无导线起搏器（Aveir AR，Abbott）与具备心房机械感知心室起搏功能的第二枚无导线起搏器（Micra AV2，Medtronic）。终点为提供心房起搏伴心室备份能力并保留心房设备寿命。摘要未报告样本量及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅描述该混合系统成功提供心房起搏与心室备份功能，并保留心房设备电池寿命。
AI.conclusion: 该病例提示，在感染起搏器拔除时联合使用Aveir AR与Micra AV2的混合无导线方案可行，可在维持房室同步的同时延长心房设备寿命；但仅为单例报告，疗效与安全性需更大样本验证。

summary_zh: 无导线起搏是器械相关感染患者的重要选择。对于需要双腔支持的患者，由于持续的植入物-植入物（i2i）通信导致的心房电池寿命缩短仍是一个问题。虽然最近的软件更新允许在临床适当时禁用i2i通信，但该模式不提供房室同步起搏。我们描述了一例混合无导线系统，结合了心房无导线起搏器（Aveir AR, Abbott）和能够进行心房机械感知心室起搏的第二无导线起搏器（Micra AV2, Medtronic），在拔除感染经静脉起搏器的情况下，提供心房起搏并具有心室备用能力，同时保持心房器械的寿命。

title: Feasibility of Left Bundle Branch Pacing and Management of Jailed Leads After Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Implantation.
summary: Atrioventricular conduction disturbances and the need for cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) therapy are frequently required after transcatheter tricuspid valve implantation (TTVI). The interaction between the annulus, transcatheter heart valve and the leads is often complex and the optimal management under debate. We prospectively included 36 patients undergoing TTVI between June 2021 and January 2025. 14 patients had a preexisting CIED. 11 patients experienced right ventricular lead-jailing without signs for early or delayed lead failure after one year, one patient underwent lead extraction and two patients had a leadless pacemaker. In four patients, a pacemaker in LBBAP was successfully implanted due to new-onset postoperative atrioventricular block. The device measurements as well as the valve function remained stable over a follow-up of at least one up to 2.5 years with persistent LBB-capture. This case series demonstrates that LBBAP following TTVI is feasible with encouraging early outcomes. Careful patient selection and dedicated follow-up are essential for patients with CIED treated with TTVI.

AI.tldr: 经导管三尖瓣植入术后新发房室传导阻滞患者行左束支起搏可行，随访期间起搏参数与瓣膜功能稳定。
AI.motivation: 经导管三尖瓣植入（TTVI）术后常需心脏植入式电子装置（CIED）治疗，但瓣环、人工瓣膜与导线相互作用复杂，最佳管理策略尚存争议，尤其左束支起搏（LBBAP）在此类患者中的可行性证据缺乏。
AI.method: 前瞻性病例系列，纳入2021年6月至2025年1月接受TTVI的36例患者；14例有既往CIED，观察导线受压（jailed lead）及导线故障，4例因术后新发房室传导阻滞尝试LBBAP；随访至少1年至2.5年，评估起搏参数与瓣膜功能。
AI.result: 11例出现右心室导线受压但1年内无早期或延迟导线故障征象；1例导线拔除，2例植入无导线起搏器；4例成功植入LBBAP起搏器，随访期间起搏参数及瓣膜功能稳定，持续左束支捕获。摘要未报告具体统计数值。
AI.conclusion: TTVI术后行LBBAP可行且早期结果令人鼓舞；对TTVI合并CIED患者需仔细筛选并专门随访。本研究为小样本病例系列，缺乏对照，结论需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh: 经导管三尖瓣植入术（TTVI）后常需处理房室传导障碍并需要心脏植入式电子装置（CIED）治疗。瓣环、经导管心脏瓣膜与导线之间的相互作用通常复杂，最佳管理策略尚存争议。我们前瞻性纳入2021年6月至2025年1月期间接受TTVI的36例患者。14例患者已有CIED。11例患者出现右心室导线受限（lead-jailing），一年后无早期或迟发导线故障迹象，1例患者接受导线拔除，2例患者植入无导线起搏器。4例患者因术后新发房室传导阻滞成功植入左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）起搏器。在至少1年至2.5年的随访中，装置测量参数及瓣膜功能保持稳定，左束支夺获持续存在。本病例系列表明，TTVI后LBBAP可行且早期结果令人鼓舞。对于接受TTVI治疗的CIED患者，仔细的患者选择和专门的随访至关重要。

title: Omnipolar Technology Near Field Versus Fragmentation Signals Mapping at Anatomically Defined Ganglionated Plexi Sites During Cardioneuroablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cardioneuroablation (CNA) is an established catheter-based therapy for refractory vasovagal syncope (VVS), targeting atrial ganglionated plexi (GPs) by radiofrequency ablation. Omnipolar Technology Near Field (OTNF) is a novel automated spectral mapping algorithm integrated within the EnSite X system; its systematic comparison with fragmentation mapping during CNA has not previously been reported.

OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the feasibility, safety, and efficacy of a streamlined, imaging-free anatomically guided CNA approach and to compare real-time OTNF mapping at three spectral thresholds with fractionation analysis in detecting GPs at anatomically consistent locations.

METHODS: Twenty-six consecutive patients (mean age 43.9 ± 16.4 years; 69% female; ≥ 3 VVS episodes/year) were enrolled prospectively at two French centres. All procedures used an HD Grid catheter for bilateral OTNF and fractionation mapping, followed by sequential ablation of five GP sites. Acute success was defined as heart rate increase > 50% from baseline and blunted atropine response (< 25% increment). Directional discordance between fractionation and OTNF map was assessed by McNemar's exact test.

RESULTS: Acute procedural success was achieved in 22 out of 26 patients (84.6%), with no complications. Mean procedure time was 95.2 ± 20.5 min. CNA produced significant vagal denervation: heart rate increased from 60.2 ± 12.9 to 88.1 ± 18.2 bpm (p < 0.003), AH interval shortened from 97.6 ± 22.9 to 78.2 ± 21.7 ms (p = 0.007), Wenckebach cycle length decreased from 441.5 ± 118.9 to 330.0 ms (p < 0.003) and SNRT decreased from 1235.0 ± 273.7 to 1028.4 ± 235.1 ms (p = 0.003). At 400 Hz, OTNF showed significantly higher signal positivity than fractionation mapping at the LSGP (concordance 57.7%) and RIGP (concordance 65.4%). At 500 and 600 Hz, no directional asymmetry was detected while concordance remained below 70% at these sites. At a median follow-up of 20.2 ± 7.6 months, 81% of patients were free from syncope.

CONCLUSIONS: A simplified, anatomical CNA approach is safe, feasible, and effective. OTNF and fragmentation signals mapping shows modest concordance at five anatomically consistent GP locations, confirming that those strategies capture partially non-overlapping electrophysiological information.

AI.tldr: 解剖引导的无影像心脏神经消融安全有效，急性成功率84.6%，随访81%无晕厥；OTNF与碎裂电位标测在GP位点一致性仅57.7%-65.4%，提示两者捕获部分不重叠的电生理信息。
AI.motivation: 心脏神经消融（CNA）是难治性血管迷走性晕厥（VVS）的既定疗法，但传统依赖影像和碎裂电位标测定位心房神经节丛（GP）。Omnipolar Technology Near Field（OTNF）是EnSite X系统的新型自动频谱标测算法，其与碎裂电位标测在CNA中的系统比较尚未见报道。
AI.method: 前瞻性、双中心研究，连续纳入26例难治性VVS患者（平均年龄43.9±16.4岁，69%女性，每年≥3次晕厥发作）。所有手术使用HD Grid导管进行双侧OTNF和碎裂电位标测，随后序贯消融5个GP位点。急性成功定义为心率较基线增加>50%且阿托品反应迟钝（增量<25%）。采用McNemar精确检验评估碎裂电位与OTNF标测的方向性不一致性。
AI.result: 急性手术成功22/26例（84.6%），无并发症。平均手术时间95.2±20.5分钟。CNA产生显著迷走去神经效应：心率从60.2±12.9增至88.1±18.2 bpm（p<0.003），AH间期从97.6±22.9缩短至78.2±21.7 ms（p=0.007），Wenckebach周期长度从441.5±118.9降至330.0 ms（p<0.003），SNRT从1235.0±273.7降至1028.4±235.1 ms（p=0.003）。在400 Hz，OTNF在LSGP（一致性57.7%）和RIGP（一致性65.4%）的信号阳性率显著高于碎裂电位标测；在500和600 Hz未检测到方向性不对称，但一致性仍低于70%。中位随访20.2±7.6个月，81%患者无晕厥复发。
AI.conclusion: 简化的解剖引导CNA安全、可行且有效，可显著去迷走神经并减少晕厥复发。OTNF与碎裂电位标测在5个解剖一致的GP位点一致性中等，提示两种策略捕获部分不重叠的电生理信息，未来需进一步明确其互补价值。

summary_zh:
背景：心脏神经消融术（CNA）是一种成熟的导管疗法，用于治疗难治性血管迷走性晕厥（VVS），通过射频消融靶向心房神经节丛（GPs）。全极技术近场（OTNF）是一种集成在EnSite X系统中的新型自动频谱标测算法；此前尚未有报道在CNA期间将其与碎裂标测进行系统性比较。

目的：评估一种简化的、无影像引导的解剖导向CNA方法的可行性、安全性和有效性，并比较在三个频谱阈值下实时OTNF标测与碎裂分析在解剖一致位置检测GPs的能力。

方法：在法国两个中心前瞻性连续入组26例患者（平均年龄43.9 ± 16.4岁；69%女性；每年≥3次VVS发作）。所有手术均使用HD Grid导管进行双侧OTNF和碎裂标测，随后对五个GP位点进行序贯消融。急性成功定义为心率较基线增加> 50%且阿托品反应迟钝（增加< 25%）。碎裂标测与OTNF标测之间的方向不一致性通过McNemar精确检验评估。

结果：26例患者中有22例（84.6%）实现急性手术成功，无并发症。平均手术时间为95.2 ± 20.5分钟。CNA产生了显著的迷走神经去神经支配：心率从60.2 ± 12.9增至88.1 ± 18.2 bpm（p < 0.003），AH间期从97.6 ± 22.9缩短至78.2 ± 21.7 ms（p = 0.007），文氏周期长度从441.5 ± 118.9降至330.0 ms（p < 0.003），SNRT从1235.0 ± 273.7降至1028.4 ± 235.1 ms（p = 0.003）。在400 Hz时，OTNF在LSGP（一致性57.7%）和RIGP（一致性65.4%）显示的信号阳性率显著高于碎裂标测。在500和600 Hz时，未检测到方向不对称性，而这些位点的一致性仍低于70%。在中位随访20.2 ± 7.6个月时，81%的患者无晕厥发作。

结论：简化的解剖CNA方法是安全、可行且有效的。OTNF与碎裂信号标测在五个解剖一致的GP位置显示出中等程度的一致性，证实这些策略捕获了部分不重叠的电生理信息。

title: Whole-Exome Sequencing Identifies a Rare CSRP3 Variant Associated With Familial Brugada Syndrome in a Lebanese Family.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Brugada syndrome (BrS) is an inherited arrhythmia associated with an increased risk of sudden cardiac death. Although traditionally regarded as a primary cardiac channelopathy, pathogenic variants in SCN5A account for only 20%-30% of clinically diagnosed cases, leaving most patients genetically unresolved. Emerging evidence suggests that structural cardiac genes may also contribute to BrS susceptibility. We investigated the genetic basis of BrS in a consanguineous Lebanese family with three affected brothers.

METHODS AND RESULTS: Whole-exome sequencing was performed in all affected individuals, followed by variant calling, annotation, and phenotype-driven prioritization using Franklin (Genoox). Candidate variants were evaluated according to allele frequency, inheritance model, segregation, and ACMG/AMP classification. Evolutionary conservation, AlphaMissense prediction, protein domain annotation, and structural modeling were performed to assess the potential functional impact of the prioritized variant. Whole-exome sequencing identified a rare homozygous CSRP3 missense variant (NM_003476.5:c.56 A > G; p.His19Arg) shared by all three affected siblings. Following exome-wide filtering under a recessive inheritance model, CSRP3 represented the only rare homozygous coding variant, while no pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants were identified in established Brugada syndrome-associated genes. The variant was absent from public population databases and an internal cohort of Lebanese exomes. His19 was highly conserved across vertebrate species, AlphaMissense classified the variant as likely pathogenic (score = 0.942), and structural modeling predicted alterations within the N-terminal LIM domain that may affect protein stability and local residue interactions.

CONCLUSIONS: Our findings nominate CSRP3 as a candidate susceptibility gene for Brugada syndrome and support the emerging role of structural cardiac genes in inherited arrhythmia syndromes. Although functional validation is required to establish causality, this study highlights the value of whole-exome sequencing in consanguineous and underrepresented populations for identifying rare candidate variants contributing to BrS susceptibility.

AI.tldr: 在一黎巴嫩近亲婚配家系的三名Brugada综合征兄弟中，全外显子测序发现共有的罕见纯合CSRP3错义变异p.His19Arg，提示结构心肌基因可能参与BrS易感。
AI.motivation: Brugada综合征是遗传性心律失常，可致心脏性猝死；但SCN5A致病变异仅解释20%-30%的临床诊断病例，多数患者遗传病因未明。近年证据提示结构心肌基因也可能参与BrS易感，本研究拟在一个近亲婚配、三兄弟患病的黎巴嫩家系中探寻BrS的遗传基础。
AI.method: 家系遗传学研究。对象为近亲婚配黎巴嫩家系中三名患病兄弟，对全部患者行全外显子测序，随后进行变异检出、注释及基于表型的优先级排序（Franklin/Genoox）。按等位基因频率、遗传模式、共分离及ACMG/AMP分类评估候选变异，并采用进化保守性分析、AlphaMissense预测、蛋白结构域注释与结构建模评估优先变异的潜在功能影响。摘要未报告具体统计方法。

title: Sequential Associations of Sleep Architecture, Nocturnal Oxygenation, and Respiratory Disturbance With a Composite PSG-Derived Rhythm-Event Index.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sleep-disordered breathing (SDB), particularly obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), has been associated with cardiovascular complications including cardiac arrhythmias. However, the relative contributions of respiratory, oxygenation, and sleep architecture indices to composite PSG-derived rhythm-event index remain incompletely understood.

OBJECTIVE: To investigate the sequential associations of sleep architecture, nocturnal oxygenation, and respiratory disturbance indices with the composite PSG-derived rhythm-event index in patients undergoing polysomnography (PSG).

METHODS: Demographic, respiratory, oxygenation and sleep-architecture variables were extracted from PSG records. The primary outcome was a composite PSG-derived rhythm-event count, estimated as round(arrhythmia index × TST_hours) from the PSG-exported arrhythmia index, which was calculated during total sleep time only. Negative binomial regression used an offset of log(TST_hours). Because the outcome demonstrated overdispersion, negative binomial regression with an offset of log(TST hours) was used. Because the original 14-predictor model was over-parameterized for the sample size, a six-predictor model (age, sex, BMI, AHI, T90, and sleep efficiency) was chosen post hoc. This reduced model was not prespecified before the original analysis. Sleep efficiency was retained because it showed a strong signal in the exploratory 14-predictor model. The resulting p-values should therefore be interpreted as optimistic and exploratory. A sequential model-building approach (Model 1: age, sex, BMI, AHI; Model 2: plus T90; Model 3: plus sleep efficiency) was used to document the incremental contribution of each domain. A fully adjusted 14-predictor model was fitted only as a supplementary analysis. Wald 95% CIs and bootstrap percentile 95% CIs (2000 resamples) are reported.

RESULTS: Forty-one participants were included (mean age 47.8 ± 13.5 years; median BMI 29.4 kg/m2). Severe OSA (AHI ≥ 30 events/hour) was present in 56.1%. Median arrhythmia index was 3.2 events/hour, with marked overdispersion. In the six-predictor model, only higher sleep efficiency was associated with lower arrhythmia rate (IRR = 0.946 per 1 percentage-point increase, 95% CI 0.921-0.972, p < 0.001; bootstrap 95% CI 0.888-0.984). T90 was associated in the Wald inference (IRR = 1.034, 95% CI 1.006-1.063, p = 0.016) but this association was not robust under bootstrap resampling (95% CI 0.979-1.067). AHI was not associated with arrhythmia rate (IRR = 1.000, 95% CI 0.987-1.014, p = 0.954). Age, sex and BMI were also not significant. A 14-predictor exploratory model had a marginally lower AIC (411.4) but a substantially higher BIC (438.8), consistent with overfitting.

CONCLUSION: In this exploratory selected sleep-center cohort, AHI and other respiratory-event indices were not independently associated with the composite PSG-derived rhythm-event index. Only higher sleep efficiency showed a robust association with lower arrhythmia rate, but this finding is hypothesis-generating and may reflect unmeasured confounding. These results require confirmation in larger prospective studies and should not guide clinical risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 在41例睡眠中心患者中，仅较高的睡眠效率与较低的复合PSG节律事件指数独立相关，而AHI等呼吸事件指标无独立关联。
AI.motivation: 睡眠呼吸障碍尤其OSA与心律失常相关，但呼吸、氧合及睡眠结构指标对复合PSG节律事件指数的相对贡献尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性分析41例PSG患者，提取人口学、呼吸、氧合及睡眠结构变量。主要终点为复合PSG节律事件计数（心律失常指数×总睡眠时间小时数，取整），采用负二项回归（offset=log总睡眠时间）。因样本量限制，事后采用六预测变量模型（年龄、性别、BMI、AHI、T90、睡眠效率），并序贯建模评估各域增量贡献；报告Wald和bootstrap 95%CI。
AI.result: 六预测变量模型中，仅睡眠效率与心律失常率降低相关（IRR=0.946/百分点，95%CI 0.921-0.972，p<0.001；bootstrap 95%CI 0.888-0.984）。T90在Wald推断中相关（IRR=1.034，95%CI 1.006-1.063，p=0.016），但bootstrap不稳健（95%CI 0.979-1.067）。AHI无关联（IRR=1.000，95%CI 0.987-1.014，p=0.954），年龄、性别、BMI亦无显著关联。
AI.conclusion: 在本探索性队列中，AHI等呼吸事件指标与复合PSG节律事件指数无独立关联，仅睡眠效率显示稳健负相关，但属假设生成性发现，可能受未测量混杂影响，需更大前瞻性研究验证，不应指导临床风险分层。

summary_zh:
背景：睡眠呼吸障碍（SDB），尤其是阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA），与包括心律失常在内的心血管并发症相关。然而，呼吸、氧合和睡眠结构指标对复合PSG衍生节律事件指数的相对贡献仍不完全清楚。

目的：探讨在接受多导睡眠图（PSG）检查的患者中，睡眠结构、夜间氧合和呼吸紊乱指数与复合PSG衍生节律事件指数的序贯关联。

方法：从PSG记录中提取人口学、呼吸、氧合和睡眠结构变量。主要结局为复合PSG衍生节律事件计数，根据PSG导出的心律失常指数估算为round(心律失常指数 × TST_小时)，该指数仅在总睡眠时间内计算。负二项回归使用log(TST_小时)作为偏移量。由于结局表现出过度离散，使用以log(TST小时)为偏移量的负二项回归。由于原始14预测变量模型对于样本量而言参数过多，事后选择了一个六预测变量模型（年龄、性别、BMI、AHI、T90和睡眠效率）。该简化模型未在原始分析前预先指定。保留睡眠效率是因为它在探索性14预测变量模型中显示出强信号。因此，所得的p值应被解释为乐观的和探索性的。采用序贯模型构建方法（模型1：年龄、性别、BMI、AHI；模型2：加T90；模型3：加睡眠效率）来记录每个领域的增量贡献。完全调整的14预测变量模型仅作为补充分析拟合。报告Wald 95% CI和bootstrap百分位95% CI（2000次重采样）。

结果：共纳入41名参与者（平均年龄47.8 ± 13.5岁；中位BMI 29.4 kg/m2）。重度OSA（AHI ≥ 30次/小时）占56.1%。中位心律失常指数为3.2次/小时，具有明显的过度离散。在六预测变量模型中，仅较高的睡眠效率与较低的心律失常发生率相关（IRR = 0.946 每增加1个百分点，95% CI 0.921-0.972，p < 0.001；bootstrap 95% CI 0.888-0.984）。T90在Wald推断中相关（IRR = 1.034，95% CI 1.006-1.063，p = 0.016），但该关联在bootstrap重采样下不稳健（95% CI 0.979-1.067）。AHI与心律失常发生率无关（IRR = 1.000，95% CI 0.987-1.014，p = 0.954）。年龄、性别和BMI也无显著性。14预测变量探索性模型的AIC略低（411.4），但BIC显著更高（438.8），与过拟合一致。

结论：在这个探索性选择的睡眠中心队列中，AHI和其他呼吸事件指数与复合PSG衍生节律事件指数无独立关联。仅较高的睡眠效率显示出与较低心律失常发生率的稳健关联，但这一发现是假设生成性的，可能反映了未测量的混杂因素。这些结果需要在更大规模的前瞻性研究中确认，不应指导临床风险分层。

title: Insertable Cardiac Monitoring in Pediatric Patients: A Real-World Single-Center Experience With a New-Generation Device.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Insertable cardiac monitors (ICMs) are increasingly used in pediatric patients, yet data on new-generation devices remain limited. The aim of this retrospective study was to describe a single-center real-world experience with a new-generation ICM in pediatric patients, focusing on procedural feasibility, sensing performance, transmission burden, and user experience.

METHODS: Consecutive patients aged ≤18 years undergoing LUX-Dx ICM implantation between 2023 and 2025 were included. Procedural characteristics, sensing parameters, transmission patterns, diagnostic yield, reprogramming strategies, and patient/caregiver-reported experience were analyzed. Data are reported as median (25th-75th percentile) or mean ± standard deviation.

RESULTS: Twenty-nine patients underwent ICM implantation. Procedures were brief (6 ± 2 min) and complication-free. Electrical parameters were satisfactory and stable at discharge. Follow-up was 18 (6-23) months. A median of 2.7 transmissions per patient-month were received, of which 55% were alerts. Time from arrhythmia detection to transmission was 15 (3-21) hours. The number of episodes per patient was 4.8 (3.1-15.9) per month, with substantial inter-patient variability and bradycardia being the most frequent detection (80%). A diagnostic conclusion was reached in 79% of patients (positive: 45%, negative: 34%) at a median of 3 months. Reprogramming was performed in 90% of patients, mainly remotely (77%), and was predominantly directed toward reducing detection sensitivity. Patient and caregiver acceptance of remote monitoring was high.

CONCLUSIONS: In pediatric patients, new-generation ICM implantation was safe, well tolerated, and associated with stable sensing performance. Remote monitoring and reprogramming enabled timely diagnosis and individualized optimization, supporting the clinical utility of contemporary ICMs in this population.

AI.method: 回顾性单中心研究，连续纳入2023至2025年接受LUX-Dx ICM植入的≤18岁患者，共29例。分析手术特征、感知参数、传输模式、诊断率、程控策略及患者/照护者报告体验。数据以中位数（四分位距）或均值±标准差报告。
AI.result: 手术时间6±2分钟，无并发症，出院时电学参数满意且稳定。随访18（6-23）个月。每患者月接收中位2.7次传输，其中55%为警报。从心律失常检测到传输时间15（3-21）小时。每患者每月发作4.8（3.1-15.9）次，患者间变异大，心动过缓最常见（80%）。79%患者在中位3个月时获得诊断结论（阳性45%，阴性34%）。90%患者进行程控，其中77%为远程程控，主要方向为降低检测灵敏度。患者和照护者对远程监测接受度高。

背景：植入式心脏监测器（ICM）在儿科患者中的应用日益增多，但关于新一代设备的数据仍然有限。本回顾性研究旨在描述单中心在儿科患者中使用新一代ICM的真实世界经验，重点关注手术可行性、感知性能、传输负担和用户体验。
